description: Submit an affiliate, referral or partner program's page to be checked and added to the directory, free. Use only when the person asks for it or agrees, typically after get_program says a program is absent. Send the URL of the vendor's own program page; a person reads the terms off that page, and anything sent as figures is only checked against it, never published. Sending the same URL again returns what happened to it. An email address, only if the person gives one, is used to tell them the outcome.

email.description: The person's email, only if they want to hear the outcome. Ask first.

notes.description: Anything already known about the terms. Checked against the page, never published.

url.description: The vendor's own affiliate program page, e.g. https://example.com/affiliates.

name: submit_program
title: Submit a program to the directory
